4: '------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5: '  HOW TO USE (Microsoft Access on Windows, 2010 or later / Microsoft 365):
6: '    1. Open Access > Blank database > name it CairnSystems.accdb > Create.
7: '    2. Close the empty "Table1" that Access opens (don't save it).
8: '    3. Press Alt+F11 to open the VBA editor.
9: '    4. File > Import File... > choose this CairnBuild.bas file.
10: '    5. Click inside "Sub BuildCairnDatabase", press F5.
11: '    6. Back in Access, press F5 (or close/reopen) to see the new tables & queries.
12: '       Database Tools > Relationships > "All Relationships" shows the diagram.
13: '
14: '  WHAT IT CREATES
15: '    Tables   : CompanyInfo, SalesReps, Customers, Contacts, Products,
16: '               Quotes, QuoteLines, Orders, OrderLines, Payments,
17: '               Activities (CRM notes/calls/meetings), PhoneMessages,

133:     ' RMA routing. Grew one IIf at a time; read the branches in order.
134:     s = "SELECT r.RMAID, r.RMANumber, r.OpenedDate, r.RMAStatus, r.Reason, r.SerialNumber, r.ExtendedWarranty, "

137:     s = s & "IIf(r.Reason='Damaged in Shipping','Carrier Claim',"
138:     s = s & "IIf(r.Reason='Dead on Arrival' And [DaysInService]<=30,'Advance Replacement',"
139:     s = s & "IIf(p.Category='Service','Account Manager',"
140:     s = s & "IIf([DaysInService]<=365 Or r.ExtendedWarranty,'Manufacturer Repair',"
141:     s = s & "IIf(r.Reason='Dead on Arrival','Advance Replacement',"

143:     s = s & "IIf(c.TaxExempt,'Account Manager',"
144:     s = s & "IIf([DaysInService]>730,'Scrap - Out of Warranty','Customer Pays Repair')))))))) AS Route "
